device_entry.name: Keithley 2015数字万用表
tags: 电子器件供电与台架测试
device_entry.description: 这是一台台式数字万用表，可用于实验室中的电阻等电学参数测量，并支持通过计算机进行自动化读数与测量模式切换。适合电子测试、器件表征和常规电学实验。
device_entry.description_en: This is a bench digital multimeter used in laboratories for measuring electrical quantities such as resistance, with support for computer-controlled automated readings and measurement mode switching. It is suitable for electronics testing, device characterization, and general electrical lab work.
